heading: Wednesday, April 8, 2026
topLine: Meta Superintelligence Labs debuts Muse Spark.

items.headline: Meta Superintelligence Labs debuts Muse Spark
items.summary: Muse Spark is the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs: a natively multimodal reasoning model with tool use and multi-agent orchestration that powers Meta AI. Unlike Llama it is not open-weight; Meta offered a private API preview and claims its Contemplating mode scores 58% on Humanity's Last Exam.
